evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/provider/builtInDrivers.ts
evidence.finding: Concrete Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity, fx, Kiro, Pi, Muse and ACP Registry drivers. Driver capability/model/permission support differs; README verification is vendor-reported, not our observation.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/provider/ProviderInstanceRegistry.ts
evidence.finding: Multiple provider instances resolve own environment/config secrets; unreadable vault entries remain unavailable. Provider Registry caches workspace capability snapshots and serializes maintenance.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/RuntimePolicy.ts
evidence.locator: providerRuntimeMode, effective runtime mode and managed limits
evidence.finding: Unsupported modes fall back to approval-required; managed machine policy caps permission level. Approval level is distinct from process/filesystem sandbox.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/mcp/delegatedTaskModes.ts
evidence.finding: Delegation cannot request a higher permission rank than its parent; target provider capability can lower the mode.

evidence.title: Moonfold: packages/contracts/src/settings.ts
evidence.finding: Supervised initial permission mode; cleanup clocks null/off, mobile and Anywhere off, provider update checks on, handoff ask, auto-resume limited threads off. Optional Connect/guest/link features have separate gates.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/mcp/OrchestratorMcpService.ts
evidence.finding: Active provider-session caller required; stable request-key command receipts deduplicate; same-project local child or linked remote target; optional worktree at parent HEAD; async completion wakes parent, wait timeout upgrades wake policy.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ThreadLaunchService.ts
evidence.finding: Native root/worktree launch with setup tracker, durable command receipt and resumable preparation. Worktree base is pinned when delegated; no container or VM allocation.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/orbit/OrbitService.ts
evidence.finding: Five scheduled crew roles, role/level admission, project mission, ranked backlog, reports and drafts. Default off/propose/12 daily runs; reconciliation every five minutes can lag concurrent starts. Role workers use root or worktree and provider Auto/auto-accept-edits. No implemented draft posting.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/orbit/crewPrompts.ts
evidence.finding: Runtime prompt strings request independent review before ship, no secret/settings edits and no posting. These instructions do not establish universal merge/test enforcement.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/scheduledTasks/ScheduledTaskService.ts
evidence.finding: Persisted schedule/once/interval/webhook tasks; root/worktree/new or existing thread. In-process active-run exclusion, missed fixed-time run skipped, 100 retained runs/task; webhook HMAC/token verification, bounded queue20/rate60 per minute and durable dedupe.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/scheduledTasks/webhookVerification.ts
evidence.finding: Authenticates supported webhook signatures before dispatch; this does not grant a general external issue tracker bidirectional state contract.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/auth/RpcAuthorization.ts
evidence.finding: Separate read/operate/settings/provider/filesystem/terminal/relay scopes for authorized client sessions; pairing/revocation belongs to one self-hosted environment.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/auth/ServerSecretStore.ts
evidence.finding: Server secret bytes under directory0700/files0600 with atomic replacement; this store is not encrypted-at-rest by itself. Separate secret-provider references can resolve external vaults.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/guest/GuestShareService.ts
evidence.finding: Optional guest link can submit messages/files and see bounded thread view under owner controls; requires configured Connect managed endpoint and guestSharing flag, not standard local multi-user team management.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/mobileAccess/MobileAccess.ts
evidence.finding: Optional pinned TLS listener on all interfaces, one-time pairing links and session revocation; paired Android displays the host workspace. Host must remain available.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/mobile/app/src/main/java/dev/moonfold/mobile/MainActivity.kt
evidence.locator: WebView origin/TLS handling, connect and update menu
evidence.finding: Native Kotlin WebView shell pins paired host certificate, tries direct connection then optional relay, shows same host UI. No iOS client here.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/mobile/app/src/main/java/dev/moonfold/mobile/Updates.kt
evidence.finding: Automatic GitHub release checks every20hours default on, native Stop checking persists false; explicit check reenables. Download verifies GitHub SHA256 and same APK signer; install asks OS owner.

evidence.title: Moonfold: infra/anywhere-relay/src/worker.ts
evidence.finding: Public Cloudflare relay code authenticates host room proof, bounds streams/buffers and copies opaque TLS bytes. Default public endpoint is named in settings; deployment log retention/region remains unverified.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/telemetry/AnalyticsService.ts
evidence.finding: No built-in project key/host; default false. Explicit environment true plus own key/host enables PostHog; machine policy may disable. Bounded event buffer/retry, installation identity and provider/usage dimensions. Config-only scoped control.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/web/src/cloud/publicConfig.ts
evidence.finding: Browser Connect tracing requires all build URL/dataset/token values; no browser toggle. Desktop bridge can suppress tracing. Separate optional custom Clerk/relay config gates Connect.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/cloud/relayTracing.ts
evidence.finding: Managed policy telemetry:false blocks configured server relay traces; separate from PostHog opt-in and user OTLP export.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/storageCleanup.ts
evidence.locator: eligibility, protected worktrees, cleanup execution and reports
evidence.finding: Optional age/merge/delete cleanup with dirty/live/shared protections; original provider logs and copied data are outside an all-data erasure promise.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionMaintenance.ts
evidence.finding: One-day event compaction preserves referenced prompts, newest stream heads and projected history. It is not one-day conversation deletion; owner database remains mutable.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/usage/usageAggregation.ts
evidence.finding: Normalizes provider token/cost records and group summaries; missing provider cost is not automatically an invoice. Own external account and compute expenses remain separate.

evidence.title: Moonfold: packages/source-control-github/src/server/GitHubPullRequestApi.ts
evidence.finding: Native PR/check/comment/review/update/merge/queue flows. Update branch binds expected head; ordinary merge only supplies expectedHeadOid when a cleaned custom commit body required it, so no universal exact-revision guarantee.

evidence.title: Moonfold: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/PullRequestWatchReactor.ts
evidence.finding: Polls host checks/comments/conflicts, scoped to current watch, publishes bounded wake and ends at fix limit; rate limits and transport failures handled separately.

evidence.title: Moonfold: README.md
evidence.finding: Desktop and self-hosted web workspace, beta installs and own CLI accounts; vendor provider checks not our observed evidence.

evidence.title: Moonfold: docs/legal/privacy.md
evidence.finding: Says no Moonfold server; conflicts with newer optional project-operated Anywhere relay. Core local mode remains independent.

evidence.title: Moonfold: docs/user/telemetry.md
evidence.finding: Separates PostHog, custom Connect tracing, activity publishing and OTLP export. iOS/mobile crash paragraph does not match current Kotlin Android source/no-iPhone guide; documentary limitation only.

evidence.title: Moonfold: docs/user/mobile-app.md
evidence.finding: Android APK, no iPhone app, optional default project-operated Anywhere relay or own relay; relay sees traffic metadata.

evidence.title: Moonfold: docs/plans/stable-1.0.md
evidence.finding: First stable release gate remains a plan with real-provider verification, fuses, performance/accessibility and Android checks outstanding.

evidence.title: Moonfold: LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT grant for local client/server/source; third-party provider terms remain separate.
